lines.text: Aniimo goes mobile tonight, Sep 22 at 10pm EDT, and update 1.1 brings the Legendary Irisalis plus an event slate starting Sep 25
Pokemon GO fills late October: Fall Marathon Oct 13-19, a Dynamax Max Battle Day Oct 24, and Halloween Part I from Oct 27
WoW: Forever Early Name Reservation is set for Oct 27 - Nov 3, with Invite-A-Friend codes emailing from Oct 20
Pokopia's first event since August: Bulbasaur's Jump Rope Contest runs through Sep 28

needs_you.action: Aniimo launches on iOS and Android tonight at 10:00 p.m. EDT (America server): at the first-login prompt, link the exact email you used in the betas or pre-registration, or your test rewards and Bonded Promise eggs will not follow you
Claim your unlocked Pokemon Horizons Celebration GO Pass rewards before they expire Sep 24 at 8pm local
Finish the $1.99 Phantump Catch Mastery paid Timed Research by 8pm local the same day, or its rewards are lost
Watch up to 12 hours of eligible WoW Twitch streams before Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT to bank the BlizzCon drops: 200 Tender, Grrgle decor, the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount and a banner toy
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the Battle.net Shop Sep 28
Jump in Bulbasaur's Jump Rope Contest before it ends Sep 28; a score of 51 or more earns the Jump Rope Trophy, and 76 or more starts paying out PokeMetal
Finish the September Traveler's Log for the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates Sep 30
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local
The $4.99 Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day ticket is only sold until Oct 3 at 5pm local, and its Timed Research must be finished during the 2-5pm event
Finish the Harvest Festival branching apple research and rank up its GO Pass by Oct 5 at 8pm local, then claim the pass rewards by Oct 7 at 8pm
Rank up GO Pass: September before rank earning stops Oct 6 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Oct 3 and 4; rewards expire Oct 8
Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7
Evolve Zorua by 9pm local on Community Day for Zoroark's exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch; the $1.99 Special Research is only worth buying before the 2-5pm event
Complete and claim the free World Space Week Timed Research (Astronaut Pikachu) by Oct 12 at 11:59pm local
Hatch with the GO Pass Deluxe: September Timed Incubator before it expires Oct 13 at 10am local
WoW: Forever Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27 (through Nov 3) for upgrade buyers; two-part names are region unique and go first come, first served

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the eight-boss Venomous Abyss plus Mythic+, PvP Season 2 and Bountiful Delves; Season 3 was previewed at BlizzCon with no start date yet.

timeline.title: BlizzCon viewership drops
timeline.detail: Watch eligible WoW streams on Twitch for 2, 4, 8 and 12 hours before Sep 27 at 10:00 a.m. PDT for 200 Trader's Tender, the Cuddly Blue Grrgle decor, the Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt mount and the Venomous Champion's Illustrious Banner toy.

timeline.title: Trading Post: friendship in September
timeline.detail: September's rotation offers the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount as the Traveler's Log reward, plus the Gummi pet and Outlet vendors with discounted returning items; spend or freeze Tender by Sep 30.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: Honor Uther and Grom at their memorials for the week-long Harvest Festival quest and its bounty of food.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest runs through Oct 6 with the new Brewer's Purple and Red transmog sets, Brewfest housing decor, the Banquet outdoor scenario, and daily Coren Direbrew runs for the Brewfest Barrel Bomber mount.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath flying mount, Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix ensemble, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28, when the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the shop.

timeline.title: Abyssal Crown Collection
timeline.detail: Azshara's Darkscale and Deepscale Raiment transmog sets and the Zothwing Darkseeker and Deepseeker mounts hit the Battle.net Shop, sold as a bundle or individually.

timeline.title: Vibrant Petalweave Collection
timeline.detail: Four floral transmog ensembles (Sunlit, Blush, Azure, Scarlet) remain in the in-game Shop and on Battle.net, sold as a bundle or individually.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta
timeline.detail: The beta runs through Oct 21 with access via the Skyborne Epic Pack or Warcraft Forever Collection, ahead of the Nov 4 global launch at 3:00 p.m. PST; the limited Collection bundle is sold through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (October)
timeline.detail: The Faire reopens Oct 3 for its usual week of tickets, profession quests and carousel buffs.

timeline.title: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Mists of Pandaria dungeon rotation runs Oct 6-13 with six Timewalking instances, the weekly quest and the Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: The Great Gnomeregan Run (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Race a level-1 gnome from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay in the annual weekend fun run.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Hallow's End runs Oct 19 - Nov 2 with daily Headless Horseman runs for his mount, candy buckets across Azeroth, and the Tricky Treat vendors.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Create and customize up to three characters and lock in two-part names, unique per region and first come, first served, with any Forever upgrade purchase before the Nov 4 launch.

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The next content update, on the PTR with no release date announced, concludes the Quel'thalas saga with the one-boss Unbinding of Kith'ix raid, Labyrinths, Aqir Invasions and Ascendant Venomstones.
timeline.estimate_basis: On the PTR; Blizzard has not announced a release date

weekly_rhythm: Week of Sep 22 (now): Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Packed House; Harvest Festival through Sep 28; Twitch drops close Sep 27 and BlizzCon bundles leave the shop Sep 28
Week of Sep 29: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deep Six; the Trading Post rolls over Sep 30, and October's lineup is not announced yet
Week of Oct 6: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard; Brewfest ends Oct 6; Darkmoon Faire through Oct 10; Gnomeregan Run Oct 10-12
Week of Oct 13: Battleground and Pet Battle Bonus Events; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Hallow's End begins Oct 19

Week of Oct 20: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; WoW: Forever beta ends Oct 21 and Invite-A-Friend launch codes start emailing Oct 20; a Talebound preview is expected on the PTR in October
Week of Oct 27 (window end): Timewalking Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown begin at reset; Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27
just_past_window: Oct 27 - Nov 3: Timewalking Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown
Nov 3-10: Midnight Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Nov 4: WoW: Forever launches globally at 3:00 p.m. PST; Invite-A-Friend guests can play Nov 4-11

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: The season runs to Dec 1 with more Paldea debuts including Maschiff and Mabosstiff, Mega Evolution debuts for Staraptor and Chandelure, and Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

timeline.title: GO Pass: September
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latios encounter; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, GO Points are uncapped Oct 3-4, rank earning ends Oct 6 at 10am local, rewards expire Oct 8 at 10am, and the Rank 20 Timed Incubator expires Oct 13.

timeline.title: GO Battle League: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Mega-Evolved Pokemon are eligible in the new Mega Editions of all three leagues this season, with a free Timed Research Pass, Ryme-inspired avatar items and a guaranteed Pikachu Libre rank-up encounter.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Pick one of three Timed Research paths, Explore, Catch or Battle, to shape your tasks and bonuses for the week; the research runs Sep 23 at 10am to Sep 28 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Phantump Catch Mastery
timeline.detail: Throw-accuracy Field Research and free Timed Research bring boosted Shiny Phantump with 2x XP and extra Candy for Nice throws or better; $1.99 paid Timed Research adds more Phantump and must be finished by 8pm local that day.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Applin Picking
timeline.detail: Shiny Applin debuts, Mossy Lures dispense Tart, Sweet and Syrupy Apples, and a branching apple Timed Research plus an event GO Pass ($4.99 Deluxe, $6.99 with 6 ranks) run to Oct 5 at 8pm local, with pass rewards claimable through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival: Taken Over
timeline.detail: Team GO Rocket floods PokeStops and balloons from Oct 2 at 12:00am to Oct 5 at 8pm local; chase Giovanni with the GO Pass Super Rocket Radar to save Shadow Zekrom, hatch the debuting Shiny Shroodle, and TM away Frustration.

timeline.title: Gigantamax Cinderace Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Cinderace fills six-star Max Battles with Shiny Gigantamax Cinderace debuting; all Power Spots host Gigantamax Battles with 8x Max Particles, a $4.99 ticket (sold until 5pm local) adds Timed Research and 2x Max Battle XP, and the remote raid limit rises to 20 from Oct 2 at 5pm to Oct 3 at 8pm PDT.

timeline.title: World Space Week
timeline.detail: Astronaut Pikachu debuts in one-star raids and free Timed Research from Oct 4 at 12:00am to Oct 10 at 11:59pm local; the research must be completed and claimed by Oct 12 at 11:59pm.

timeline.title: Zorua Community Day
timeline.detail: Zorua swarms with boosted Shiny odds and Special Backgrounds from 2pm to 5pm local; evolve by 9pm for Zoroark's Fast Attack Sucker Punch, with a $1.99 Special Research and Zorua drawn to regular Lures until 9pm.

timeline.title: Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek
timeline.detail: A week-long walking event runs Oct 13 at 10am to Oct 19 at 8pm local; Niantic has not posted details yet.

timeline.title: Hatch Day
timeline.detail: A Hatch Day runs Oct 17 from 11am to 5pm local; the featured hatching Pokemon has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Dynamax Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: A Dynamax Max Battle Day runs Oct 24 from 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Pokemon has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Halloween Part I opens at the window's edge, Oct 27 at 10am through Oct 31 at 8pm local; contents are not announced yet, with Part II following Nov 1-5.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Spotlight Hours: Rattata Sep 24; Seedot Oct 1; Elgyem Oct 8; Stufful Oct 15; Morelull Oct 22
Max Mondays: Sobble Sep 28; Sizzlipede Oct 5; Rookidee Oct 12; Sneasel Oct 19; Sableye Oct 26
5-star raids: Zamazenta through Sep 22; Xurkitree, Pheromosa and Buzzwole Sep 23-29; Xerneas Sep 30 - Oct 6; Yveltal Oct 7-13; Dialga Oct 14-20; Palkia Oct 21-27; Giratina (Origin) follows Oct 28
Raid Hours: the Ultra Beast trio Sep 23; Xerneas Sep 30; Yveltal Oct 7; Dialga Oct 14; Palkia Oct 21

Mega Raids: Malamar Sep 23-29; Victreebel Sep 30 - Oct 6; Blastoise Oct 7-13; Dragonite Oct 14-20; Charizard X and Y Oct 21-27; Shadow Thundurus in weekend Shadow Raids through Oct 6, then Shadow Landorus
GO Battle League: Retro Cup Sep 22-29; Mega Color Cup Sep 29 - Oct 6; Mega Editions of all three leagues Oct 6-13; Little Cup Oct 13-20; Fantasy Cup Oct 20-27; Mega Halloween Cup from Oct 27
Season 24's remaining Community Days are Oct 10 (Zorua) and Nov 21; GO Pass: October has not been announced yet
just_past_window: Oct 31: Super Mega Raid Day, 2-5pm local

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Bulbasaur's Jump Rope Contest
timeline.detail: The April jump rope event returns through Sep 28, solo or with island visitors; scores pay out Leppa Berries up through the Jump Rope Trophy at 51 and stacks of Rare PokeMetal from 101.

timeline.title: PokemonXP and Worlds Cloud Island
timeline.detail: Grab the mysterious goggles from any Pokemon Center in an area at environment level 3 or above and enter address JW7MXKP2 to tour the Worlds stage island; no end date has been announced.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass by Aug 31, 2027 also emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with accessories, new furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; dates confirmed by Pawprint

timeline.title: Mobile launch
timeline.detail: iOS and Android go live on the America server Sep 22 at 10:00 p.m. EDT on the same servers as PC and console; pre-download is open now and needs 18 GB free plus Vulkan 1.1 on Android.

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: At the first-login Link Email prompt, enter the email you used for betas, pre-registration or web events and verify it, or those rewards and Bonded Promise eggs stay on the old account; check what you are owed at aniimo.com/act/rebate.

timeline.title: Update 1.1: Setting Out in Pursuit of the Wind
timeline.detail: Servers go down Sep 23 from 00:00 to 10:00 UTC+8 for the version 1.1 update (500 Glimmer compensation), adding the Holo-Battle Interlink weekly co-op mode and Egg Heist Chaos Mode.

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis debuts
timeline.detail: The Legendary Journey season runs Sep 25 10:00 to Dec 10 07:59 UTC+8: collect weekly Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod for Irisalis, then a guaranteed-capture Aniipod with Perfect Innate Potential and Sparkling Form.

timeline.title: Glamour Star: Floral Soiree
timeline.detail: Dress an Aniimo to the Floral Soiree audition theme and submit it for scoring before the event ends Oct 2 at 03:59 UTC+8; score milestones pay out rewards.

timeline.title: Aniimo Discovery
timeline.detail: Track a brand-new Aniimo across Idyll with periodically refilled free Search Attempts (unspent free attempts do not stack) and research quests that unlock Search Buffs; runs to Oct 9 at 03:59 UTC+8.

timeline.title: Vein Abundance spawns
timeline.detail: Prismana Form Melloblum appears at Rosetower Woods Sep 28 - Oct 5, then Prismana Form Waleetle at Berylline Vale Oct 5-12 (times 04:00 UTC+8).

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Log in on enough days between Oct 1 and Oct 29 (04:00 UTC+8) to claim the full set of travel gifts.

weekly_rhythm: Holo-Battle Interlink runs weekly from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 UTC+8 after the Sep 23 update, with Star Rank and Support rewards resetting each cycle
Egg Heist Chaos Mode opens Sep 24 (UTC+8) for Tier IV Elite Egg Seekers and costs a Chaos Ticket per run
Shop adds the Radiant Waveglow appearance set (980 Lumin Crystals) and the Laurel Moon Blessing pack (280) with the update
just_past_window: Oct 29: Journey Chronicles login rewards end (UTC+8)
